LightMode.d: The lightmode. A light can be real-time, mixed, baked or unknown. Unknown lights will be ignored by the baking backends.

LightType.Point.d: A point light emitting light in all directions.
The light is a point light.

LightType.Rectangle.d: A light shaped like a rectangle emitting light into the hemisphere that it is facing.
The light is a rectangle shaped area light. It affects only baked lightmaps and lightprobes.

LightType.Spot.d: A spot light emitting light in a direction with a cone shaped opening angle.

Joint2D.enableCollision.d: Should the two rigid bodies connected with this joint collide with each other?

JointAngleLimits2D.d: Angular limits on the rotation of a Rigidbody2D object around a HingeJoint2D.

JointBreakAction2D.d: Options for selecting which action to take when a Joint2D breaks.

JointBreakAction2D.CallbackOnly.d: When the Joint2D breaks, call Joint2D.OnJointBreak2D but take no other action.

JointBreakAction2D.Destroy.d: When the Joint2D breaks, call Joint2D.OnJointBreak2D and then destroy the component.

JointBreakAction2D.Disable.d: When the Joint2D breaks, call Joint2D.OnJointBreak2D and then disable the component.

JointBreakAction2D.Ignore.d: When the Joint2D breaks, no action will be taken and Joint2D.OnJointBreak2D will not be called.

JointLimitState2D.d: Represents the state of a joint limit.

JointLimitState2D.EqualLimits.d: Represents a state where the joint limit is at the specified lower and upper limits (they are identical).

JointLimitState2D.Inactive.d: Represents a state where the joint limit is inactive.

JointLimitState2D.LowerLimit.d: Represents a state where the joint limit is at the specified lower limit.

JointLimitState2D.UpperLimit.d: Represents a state where the joint limit is at the specified upper limit.

JointMotor2D.d: Parameters for the optional motor force applied to a Joint2D.

JointMotor2D.maxMotorTorque.d: The maximum force that can be applied to the Rigidbody2D at the joint to attain the target speed.

JointMotor2D.motorSpeed.d: The desired speed for the Rigidbody2D to reach as it moves with the joint.

JointSuspension2D.d: Joint suspension is used to define how suspension works on a WheelJoint2D.

JointSuspension2D.angle.d: The world angle (in degrees) along which the suspension will move.

JointSuspension2D.dampingRatio.d: The amount by which the suspension spring force is reduced in proportion to the movement speed.

JointSuspension2D.frequency.d: The frequency at which the suspension spring oscillates.

JointTranslationLimits2D.d: Motion limits of a Rigidbody2D object along a SliderJoint2D.

JointTranslationLimits2D.max.d: Maximum distance the Rigidbody2D object can move from the Slider Joint's anchor.

JointTranslationLimits2D.min.d: Minimum distance the Rigidbody2D object can move from the Slider Joint's anchor.

Physics2D.d: Global settings and helpers for 2D physics.

Physics2D.alwaysShowColliders.d: Enable to always show the Collider Gizmos even when they are not selected.

Physics2D.angularSleepTolerance.d: A Rigidbody cannot sleep if its angular velocity is above this tolerance threshold.

Physics2D.autoSimulation.d: Set whether the physics should be simulated automatically or not.

Physics2D.autoSyncTransforms.d: Set whether to automatically sync changes to the Transform component with the physics engine.

Physics2D.baumgarteScale.d: The scale factor that controls how fast overlaps are resolved.

Physics2D.baumgarteTOIScale.d: The scale factor that controls how fast TOI overlaps are resolved.

Physics2D.callbacksOnDisable.d: Use this to control whether or not the appropriate OnCollisionExit2D or OnTriggerExit2D callbacks should be called when a Collider2D is disabled.

Physics2D.changeStopsCallbacks.d: Set whether the reporting of collisions callbacks immediately stops if any of the objects involved in the collision are deleted or moved.

Physics2D.colliderAABBColor.d: Set the color used by the Gizmos to show all Collider axis-aligned bounding boxes (AABBs).

Physics2D.colliderAsleepColor.d: The color used by the Gizmos to show all asleep Colliders (Collider is asleep when the body is asleep).

Physics2D.colliderAwakeColor.d: The color used by the Gizmos to show all awake Colliders (Collider is awake when the body is awake).

Physics2D.colliderContactColor.d: The color used by the Gizmos to show all Collider contacts.

Physics2D.contactArrowScale.d: The scale of the contact arrow used by the Collider Gizmos.

Physics2D.defaultContactOffset.d: The default contact offset of the newly created Colliders.

Physics2D.defaultPhysicsScene.d: The PhysicsScene2D automatically created when Unity starts.

Physics2D.deleteStopsCallbacks.d: Set whether to continue or stop the proccesing of collision callbacks if any of the objects involved in the collision are deleted.

Physics2D.jobOptions.d: A set of options that control how physics operates when using the job system to multithread the physics simulation.

Physics2D.linearSleepTolerance.d: A rigid-body cannot sleep if its linear velocity is above this tolerance.

Physics2D.maxAngularCorrection.d: The maximum angular position correction used when solving constraints. This helps to prevent overshoot.

Physics2D.maxLinearCorrection.d: The maximum linear position correction used when solving constraints. This helps to prevent overshoot.

Physics2D.maxRotationSpeed.d: The maximum angular speed of a rigid-body per physics update. Increasing this can cause numerical problems.

Physics2D.maxTranslationSpeed.d: The maximum linear speed of a rigid-body per physics update. Increasing this can cause numerical problems.

Physics2D.minPenetrationForPenalty.d: This property is obsolete. You should use defaultContactOffset instead.

Physics2D.positionIterations.d: The number of iterations of the physics solver when considering objects' positions.

Physics2D.queriesHitTriggers.d: Do raycasts detect Colliders configured as triggers?

Physics2D.raycastsHitTriggers.d: Set the raycasts to either detect or not detect Triggers.

Physics2D.raycastsStartInColliders.d: Do ray/line casts that start inside a Collider(s) detect those Collider(s)?

Physics2D.simulationMode.d: Controls when Unity executes the 2D physics simulation.

Physics2D.timeToSleep.d: The time in seconds that a rigid-body must be still before it will go to sleep.

Physics2D.velocityIterations.d: The number of iterations of the physics solver when considering objects' velocities.

Physics2D.velocityThreshold.d: Any collisions with a relative linear velocity below this threshold will be treated as inelastic.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.islandSolverJointCos.d: Scales the cost of each joint during discrete island solving.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.newContactsPerJob.d: Controls the minimum number of new contacts to find in each simulation job.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.syncContinuousFixtur.d: Controls the minimum number of fixtures to synchronize in the broadphase during continuous island solving in each simulation job.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.syncDiscreteFixtures.d: Controls the minimum number of fixtures to synchronize in the broadphase during discrete island solving in each simulation job.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.updateTriggerContact.d: Controls the minimum number of trigger contacts to update in each simulation job.

PhysicsJobOptions2D.useConsistencySortin.d: Should physics simulation sort multi-threaded results to maintain processing order consistency?

ParticleSystemBakeMeshOptions.BakePositi.d: Bake the Transform position into the mesh.

ParticleSystemCullingMode.AlwaysSimulate.d: Continue simulating the Particle System when it is offscreen.

ParticleSystemCullingMode.Automatic.d: For looping effects, the simulation is paused when offscreen, and for one-shot effects, the simulation will continue playing.

ParticleSystemCullingMode.Pause.d: Pause the Particle System simulation when it is offscreen.

ParticleSystemCurveMode.Curve.d: Use a single curve for the ParticleSystem.MinMaxCurve.

ParticleSystemForceField.directionY.d: Apply a linear force along the local Y axis to particles within the volume of the Force Field.

ParticleSystemForceField.directionZ.d: Apply a linear force along the local Z axis to particles within the volume of the Force Field.

ParticleSystemForceField.drag.d: Apply drag to particles within the volume of the Force Field.

ParticleSystemForceField.endRange.d: Determines the size of the shape used for influencing particles.

ParticleSystemForceField.length.d: Describes the length of the Cylinder when using the Cylinder Force Field shape to influence particles.

ParticleSystemForceField.rotationRandomn.d: Apply randomness to the Force Field axis that particles will travel around.

ParticleSystemForceField.rotationSpeed.d: The speed at which particles are propelled around a vortex.

ParticleSystemForceField.shape.d: Selects the type of shape used for influencing particles.

ParticleSystemForceField.vectorFieldAttr.d: Controls how strongly particles are dragged into the vector field motion.

ParticleSystemForceField.vectorFieldSpee.d: The speed at which particles are propelled through the vector field.

ParticleSystemForceFieldShape.d: The type of shape used for influencing particles in the Force Field Component.

ParticleSystemForceFieldShape.Box.d: Influence particles inside a box shape.

ParticleSystemForceFieldShape.Cylinder.d: Influence particles inside a cylinder shape.

ParticleSystemForceFieldShape.Hemisphere.d: Influence particles inside a hemisphere shape.

ParticleSystemForceFieldShape.Sphere.d: Influence particles inside a sphere shape.

ParticleSystemGameObjectFilter.d: The particle GameObject filtering mode that specifies which objects are used by specific Particle System modules.

ParticleSystemGameObjectFilter.LayerMask.d: Include objects based on a layer mask, where all objects that match the mask are included.
Include objects based on both a layer mask and an explicitly provided list.

ParticleSystemGameObjectFilter.List.d: Include objects based on an explicitly provided list.

ParticleSystemGradientMode.Color.d: Use a single color for the ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient.

ParticleSystemGradientMode.Gradient.d: Use a single color gradient for the ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient.

ParticleSystemGradientMode.RandomColor.d: Define a list of colors in the ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient, to be chosen from at random.

ParticleSystemGradientMode.TwoColors.d: Use a random value between 2 colors for the ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient.

ParticleSystemGradientMode.TwoGradients.d: Use a random value between 2 color gradients for the ParticleSystem.MinMaxGradient.

ParticleSystemGravitySource.d: Options for which physics system to use the gravity setting from.

ParticleSystemGravitySource.Physics2D.d: Use gravity from the 2D physics system.

ParticleSystemGravitySource.Physics3D.d: Use gravity from the 3D physics system.

ParticleSystemRenderMode.d: The rendering mode for particle systems.

ParticleSystemRenderMode.Billboard.d: Render particles as billboards facing the active camera. (Default)

ParticleSystemRenderMode.HorizontalBillb.d: Render particles as billboards always facing up along the y-Axis.

ParticleSystemRenderMode.Stretch.d: Stretch particles in the direction of motion.

ParticleSystemRenderMode.VerticalBillboa.d: Render particles as billboards always facing the player, but not pitching along the x-Axis.

ParticleSystemRenderSpace.d: How particles are aligned when rendered.

ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Local.d: Particles align with their local transform.

ParticleSystemRenderSpace.Velocity.d: Particles are aligned to their direction of travel.

ParticleSystemRingBufferMode.d: Control how particles are removed from the Particle System.

ParticleSystemRingBufferMode.Disabled.d: Particles are removed when their age exceeds their lifetime.

ParticleSystemRingBufferMode.LoopUntilRe.d: Particle ages loop until they need to be removed. Particles are removed when creating new particles would exceed the Max Particles property.

ParticleSystemRingBufferMode.PauseUntilR.d: Particle ages pause at the end of their lifetime until they need to be removed. Particles are removed when creating new particles would exceed the Max Particles…

ParticleSystemScalingMode.d: Control how particle systems apply transform scale.

ParticleSystemScalingMode.Hierarchy.d: Scale the Particle System using the entire transform hierarchy.

ParticleSystemScalingMode.Local.d: Scale the Particle System using only its own transform scale. (Ignores parent scale).

ParticleSystemScalingMode.Shape.d: Only apply transform scale to the shape component, which controls where particles are spawned, but does not affect their size or movement.

ParticleSystemShapeMultiModeValue.d: The mode used to generate new points in a shape.

ParticleSystemShapeMultiModeValue.BurstS.d: Distribute new particles around the shape evenly.

ParticleSystemShapeMultiModeValue.Loop.d: Animate the emission point around the shape.

ParticleSystemShapeMultiModeValue.PingPo.d: Animate the emission point around the shape, alternating between clockwise and counter-clockwise directions.

ParticleSystemShapeType.Box.d: Emit from the volume of a box.

ParticleSystemShapeType.BoxEdge.d: Emit from the edges of a box.

ParticleSystemShapeType.BoxShell.d: Emit from the surface of a box.

ParticleSystemShapeType.CircleEdge.d: Emit from the edge of a circle.

ParticleSystemShapeType.Cone.d: Emit from the base of a cone.

ParticleSystemShapeType.ConeShell.d: Emit from the base surface of a cone.

ParticleSystemShapeType.ConeVolumeShell.d: Emit from the surface of a cone.

ParticleSystemShapeType.HemisphereShell.d: Emit from the surface of a half-sphere.

ParticleSystemShapeType.SkinnedMeshRende.d: Emit from a skinned mesh renderer.

ParticleSystemShapeType.SphereShell.d: Emit from the surface of a sphere.

ParticleSystemSortMode.Depth.d: Sort based on depth from the camera plane.

ParticleSystemSortMode.Distance.d: Sort based on distance to the camera position. For orthographic cameras, this mode is the same as sorting by depth.

ParticleSystemSortMode.OldestInFront.d: Sort the oldest particles to the front.

ParticleSystemSortMode.YoungestInFront.d: Sort the youngest particles to the front.

ParticleSystemStopAction.d: The action to perform when the Particle System stops.

ParticleSystemStopAction.Callback.d: Call MonoBehaviour.OnParticleSystemStopped on all scripts attached to the same GameObject.

ParticleSystemStopAction.Destroy.d: Destroy the GameObject containing the Particle System.

ParticleSystemStopAction.Disable.d: Disable the GameObject containing the Particle System.

ParticleSystemStopBehavior.d: The behavior to apply when calling ParticleSystem.Stop|Stop.

ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmitting.d: Stops Particle System emitting any further particles. All existing particles will remain until they expire.

ParticleSystemStopBehavior.StopEmittingA.d: Stops Particle System emitting and removes all existing emitted particles.

When spawning new particles, use the duration and age properties from the parent system, when sampling MainModule curves in the Sub-Emitter.
When spawning new particles, inherit all available properties from the parent particles.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.d: The events that cause new particles to be spawned.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.Birth.d: Spawns new particles when particles from the parent system are born.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.Collision.d: Spawns new particles when particles from the parent system collide with something.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.Death.d: Spawns new particles when particles from the parent system die.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.Manual.d: Spawns new particles when triggered from script using ParticleSystem.TriggerSubEmitter.

ParticleSystemSubEmitterType.Trigger.d: Spawns new particles when particles from the parent system pass conditions in the Trigger Module.

ParticleSystemTrailMode.d: Choose how Particle Trails are generated.

ParticleSystemTrailMode.PerParticle.d: Makes a trail behind each particle as the particle moves.

ParticleSystemTrailMode.Ribbon.d: Draws a line between each particle, connecting the youngest particle to the oldest.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.d: Choose how textures are applied to Particle Trails.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.Distribut.d: Map the texture once along the entire length of the trail, assuming all vertices are evenly spaced.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.RepeatPer.d: Repeat the texture along the trail, repeating at a rate of once per trail segment. To adjust the tiling rate, use Material.SetTextureScale.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.Static.d: Trails do not change the texture coordinates of existing points when they add or remove points.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.Stretch.d: Map the texture once along the entire length of the trail.

ParticleSystemTrailTextureMode.Tile.d: Repeat the texture along the trail. To set the tiling rate, use Material.SetTextureScale.

ParticleSystemTriggerEventType.Exit.d: Trigger when particles leave the collision volume.

ParticleSystemTriggerEventType.Inside.d: Trigger when particles are inside the collision volume.

ParticleSystemTriggerEventType.Outside.d: Trigger when particles are outside the collision volume.
